fileRules: Upload the PNG the card gives you. Embroidery: the 600 dpi file in Printful's thread colours. Print: the 300 dpi file in brand colours. Both are true size with a transparent background.
Set the width in inches from the card. Never resize an embroidery file to another size: each size is its own drawing. Print files can scale.
Printful digitizes the PNG itself; no stitch file needed. Up to 6 threads per placement, flat colours only.

Printful's minimums: text 6.35 mm tall, lines 1.27 mm. Its disclaimer adds that shapes under 3 mm apart may be joined by connecting stitches, and every design here has letter gaps of 1.5 to 2.4 mm and channels of 1.0 to 1.5 mm. The logo's and clock's finest parts are also under the 1.27 mm line minimum: check them all on a sew-out.
3D puff: hat fronts only (catalogue copies also list the Cuffed Beanie; the RIO is disputed). Lines 5 to 12.5 mm, gaps at least 1.27 mm, and no flat stitching in the same placement.

decisions: Shipping

Customers now pay Printful's shipping, not yours. Printful put every product in eight shipping profiles of its own (hats in four), with flat rates in US$ and no free shipping: to Canada US$7.29 to 10.59, to the US US$4.69 to 8.79 (each profile's rates are on the Costs tab). Your store sells in C$, so check what those come to at checkout. Shopify charges every profile in a cart: a Retro Trucker and a 5-Panel to Canada pay US$15.78, a cap or bucket hat and a hoodie US$18.48, a beanie and a hoodie US$17.88. Your own profile (C$12, free from C$75, Express C$20) is empty and covers Canada only: the US zone added on 29 Oct isn't in it any more. Printful's profiles also list zones outside Canada and the US; your markets decide who can buy. Your call: keep Printful's rates, change them, or move everything back to your profile and add the US. Printful files every variant it links in its own profiles, so decide after the checklist and look at the profiles again when you're done. To test, go to checkout with a Canadian and a US address and stop before paying: a paid order goes to Printful.
